summary: This is a static single-image task, so PROC-CT-004 applies and replaces the multi-view criteria of PROC-CT-001 (which need two lights and an oblique view and cannot be checked). PROC-CT-002 covers crazing, which does not match here because the feature is a single dominant line rather than a cobweb network. The approved reference was fetched (obs_02) and shows only uniform speckled glaze. obs_01 shows a localized curved brownish band from the top edge to the left edge that breaks the uniform speckle texture, and the comparison reports matches_reference=false with no counterpart on the reference. This meets CT-4 for a suspected defect. The rest of the surface is uniform and matches the reference. The feature may be a foreign fiber or a glaze fissure, but under CT-4 it is a localized deviation absent from the reference, so I report suspected defect for human follow-up.
